body:
> Landscape should place the notch on the left, and Reverse Landscape on the right. While Android behaves as expected, iOS is doing the exact opposite.

It is already the case for iPad orientations, but I think it was deliberately different for iPhone for some reason (old Apple docs showing home button to the left as the primary landscape, or something like this), not sure if it is still relevant, and what's the expectation of most users.

It should be also noted that all apps on iPad will require to support all orientations, due to multitasking. Currently, this property has some effect only because of `UIRequiresFullScreen`, which is deprecated and will be removed in next iOS release.
